unsigned_notice: UNSIGNED TEST BUILD - This package is not signed and is built for testing only.

fixed_sentences.what_it_does: Dexmond MIE checks files and reports what it finds. It has not been tested against real malware.
fixed_sentences.account_boundary: Other user accounts on this computer cannot control MIE. Programs that run under your own account can.
fixed_sentences.linux_scope: This version does not judge Linux programs. It checks Windows programs, scripts, documents and archives.
fixed_sentences.no_scan_engine: This build contains the background service and the command line only. The scan engine is not part of this build. Nothing is being scanned.

windows.autostart_task: Start MIE's background service when I sign in
windows.welcome_heading_unsigned: Welcome to Dexmond MIE Setup (UNSIGNED TEST BUILD)
windows.uninstall_userdata_prompt: Remove MIE's user data folder at %LOCALAPPDATA%\DexmondMIE? Select No to keep your data folder, or Yes to delete it.
windows.install_location_note: Installed files are placed in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Dexmond MIE.
windows.userdata_location_note: User data is stored in %LOCALAPPDATA%\DexmondMIE. Uninstalling asks whether to keep or remove that folder and keeps it by default.

linux.deb_synopsis_unsigned: Dexmond MIE file checker - UNSIGNED TEST BUILD
linux.install_location_note: Installed files are placed under /opt/dexmond-mie, with a command-line wrapper at /usr/bin/mie and a per-user sign-in entry at /etc/xdg/autostart/dexmond-mie-service.desktop.
linux.userdata_location_note: User data in your home folder is stored in ~/.local/share/dexmond-mie (or $XDG_DATA_HOME/dexmond-mie), and the per-user service socket is placed in $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/dexmond-mie (or ~/.cache/dexmond-mie when XDG_RUNTIME_DIR is unset). Removing or purging the package does not touch files in your home folder.

common.licenses_note: Third-party licence texts and notices are in the licenses folder alongside this file.
common.qt_replaceable_note: When the graphical window is included, the Qt 6 libraries are separate files in the install folder and may be replaced by your own build of the same Qt version.
